Lemma
[Schauder estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0291, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0292 1. ch34:34.16\group Harmonic Maps with Boundary

For every $U\in C^{2,\alpha }(TM)$ with $U_\perp =0$ on $\partial M$, \[ \| U\| _{C^{2,\alpha }} \le C\| {-\Delta U-\Rc (U)}\| _{C^\alpha } +C\| ( abla _NU)_{ op }-\mathrm{II}(U)\| _{C^{1,\alpha }(T\partial M)}. \]
Proof

\sketch The complementing boundary condition gives the usual estimate with an additional $C^0$-term. Interpolation bounds the $C^2$-norm by a small multiple of the top Hölder seminorm plus the $C^0$-norm, and compactness gives $\| U\| _{C^0}\le \varepsilon \| abla U\| _{C^0}+C_\varepsilon \| U\| _{L^2}$. Finally, coercivity of $I$, Cauchy–Schwarz, and the trace theorem bound the $L^2$-term by the interior and boundary data. Choosing the small constants so that derivative terms are absorbed proves the estimate.

□
